sn19.17:1.1: Idhāham āvuso Gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ bhikkhuṃ {vehāsaṃ} gacchantaṃ || || Tassa saṅghāṭī pi ādittā sampajjalitā sajotibhūtā || patto pi āditto sampajjalito sajotibhūto || Kāyabandhanam pi ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūtaṃ || Kāyo pi āditto sampajjalito sajotibhūto || || So sudaṃ aṭṭassaraṃ karoti || || Eso bhikkhave bhikkhu Kassapassa sammāsambuddhassa pāvacane pāpabhikkhu ahosi || || Sattamaṃ || ||
